what: Each result this repository states, the exact sentence where it stands, how it is reproduced, and whether it can be reproduced from this repository. Checked fail-closed by research_grade.py. The experiments need PyTorch, snnTorch and Brian2 (requirements.txt) and are not run in CI; 'custodian-run' means the author ran the shipped script, not that CI did.

claims.claim: A 2-layer spiking network goes from chance to 91.2% MNIST accuracy after 2 short passes.
claims.exact: 9.0% before training (chance) → **91.2%** after 2 short passes, in 19 s.
claims.limits: One seeded run on one CPU; no run log is shipped, and the 19 s depends on the machine. Library versions are pinned, but floating-point results can still vary with threads and builds.

claims.claim: Ten LIF neurons stay silent below threshold and fire at rising rates above it.
claims.exact: 0 spikes/s at 5–14 mV; 45→155 spikes/s at 17–32 mV.
claims.limits: A deterministic demonstration of a textbook neuron model, not a learning result; no run log is shipped.

claims.claim: The first STDP run was null: the output neuron never fired.
claims.limits: Kept as a null; no run log is shipped.

claims.claim: The second STDP run reached a 1.42x ratio and missed the pre-declared 2x bar.
claims.limits: One seed; no run log is shipped.

claims.claim: The third STDP run, 120 s as the only declared change, reached 3.1x and met the bar.
claims.limits: The shipped control log for sync inputs, seed 1, reads group=1.76 rest=0.56 ratio=3.15, the same run's figures. Three seeds each of sync and async controls are shipped; the claim rests on one seed.

claims.claim: Three designs for three-neuron competition (exp5, its +3 mV tweak, exp6) did not pass their pre-committed bars.
claims.limits: A reported failure; tuning was stopped rather than searched. Superseded by exp7 (SE-R1): this code drops the noise->output synapses, and the reported failure shape was one seed on that code. Kept as the record. No run logs are shipped.

claims.claim: On corrected code across seeds 1-8, an early blocked curriculum passes no more seeds than the exp6 control.
claims.limits: Eight seeds, one machine, run 2026-10-20 in the author's lab. No run log is shipped; the figures are in the README as recorded.

claims.claim: Uniform forgetting in place of normalisation passes no seed and silences the network.
claims.exact: Normalise **0/8**, forget **0/8**: forgetting overshot and silenced the network.
claims.limits: Eight seeds, one machine, run 2026-10-20 in the author's lab. No run log is shipped; the figures are in the README as recorded.

claims.claim: Consolidation-gated forgetting passes no seed (a cold start); normalisation sits near 1.9x.
claims.exact: Normalise **0/8**, consolidate **0/8**: a cold start silenced it; normalisation sits near 1.9×.
claims.limits: Eight seeds, one machine, run 2026-10-20 in the author's lab. No run log is shipped; the figures are in the README as recorded.

claims.claim: Warmup then consolidated forgetting passes no seed; selectivity collapses.
claims.exact: Normalise **0/8**, warmup-forget **0/8**: the network stayed alive but selectivity collapsed.
claims.limits: Eight seeds, one machine, run 2026-10-20 in the author's lab. No run log is shipped; the figures are in the README as recorded.

claims.claim: A dedicated inhibitory population passes no seed and tracks direct inhibition within 0.08.
claims.exact: Direct **0/8**, inhibitory population **0/8**; per-seed ratios within 0.08 of each other (`exp11_out.txt`).
claims.limits: Eight seeds, one machine, run 2026-10-20 in the author's lab. The shipped log holds the per-seed figures.

claims.claim: A single global inhibitory node passes no seed and tracks direct inhibition within 0.08.
claims.exact: Direct **0/8**, global node **0/8**; per-seed ratios within 0.08 of each other (`exp12_out.txt`).
claims.limits: Eight seeds, one machine, run 2026-10-20 in the author's lab. The shipped log holds the per-seed figures.

claims.claim: A shuffled-burst null reaches ratio 1.64 against 1.84; pre-registered reading mostly by construction.
claims.exact: Ratio 1.64 against 1.84; pre-registered reading "mostly by construction". (`exp14_out.txt`)
claims.limits: Eight seeds, one machine, run 2026-11-09 in the author's lab; pre-registration in prereg/. The shipped log holds the per-seed figures.

claims.claim: The coincidence-free null reaches 1.07 with outputs nearly silent; its verdict is set aside after the fact.
claims.exact: Ratio 1.07; outputs nearly silent (0-9 spikes), so its "pattern learning" verdict is set aside. (`exp15_out.txt`)
claims.limits: Eight seeds, one machine, run 2026-11-09 in the author's lab; pre-registration in prereg/. The shipped log holds the per-seed figures.

claims.claim: The score is 1.07 at t = 0 before any learning, and its rise lies in the burst synapses.
claims.exact: The score is 1.07 before any learning; the rise is in the burst synapses. (`exp16_out.txt`)
claims.limits: Eight seeds, one machine, run 2026-11-09 in the author's lab; pre-registration in prereg/. The shipped log holds the per-seed figures.

claims.claim: Burst-synapse selectivity passes its pre-registered test on new seeds 9-16.
claims.exact: **PASS**: >= 2.0 on 7/8, above start 8/8, above a 1000-relabeling null 8/8. (`exp17_out.txt`)
claims.limits: One architecture (direct inhibition), eight new seeds 9-16, one machine, run 2026-11-09; the measure was chosen after seeing seeds 1-8 and pre-registered before this run (prereg/). The shipped log holds the per-seed figures.
